scientific_integrity: Original finite checks are auxiliary; the global statement follows from explicit Lyapunov and dynamical proofs. Mathematical review within the present manuscript is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Above the threshold, stable cycles are constructed only for sufficiently small cd-b; no basin census, high-amplitude classification, or noise robustness is asserted. Publication priority is subject to unindexed work.
title: A sharp global relaxation boundary and a supercritical Hopf lattice for a sinusoidal jerk flow
